pr-open.note: Open the PR from the loop branch. The body is performed byte for byte.

issue-comment.note: Comment on an issue. The custodian adds the marker; the agent never writes one.
issue-comment.world_key: marker (loop, attempt, index) in the comment body

criteria-tick.note: Tick one criterion in the issue body.

deviation.note: Recorded only. Nothing is written to GitHub.

review-findings.note: Reviewer only. Its lookup, replay and supervision are declared with the reviewer kind. Never in a coder's allowed_effects.

flagged-for-human.note: Effects are performed, then the loop parks agent_flagged with the text attached byte for byte.

blocked.note: Effects are performed, then the loop parks agent_blocked with the reason attached byte for byte.
